review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–70). It has no @[simp] attributes. The declarations are inequalities (AddHom.le_map_tsub, le_mul_tsub, le_tsub_mul, AddMonoidHom.le_map_tsub) and two conditional equalities. The equalities are map_tsub_of_le, which needs the hypothesis b ≤ a, and OrderIso.map_tsub, which needs a h_add hypothesis. None of these is a good simp lemma. The inequalities are not rewrite rules. The conditional equalities have side goals that simp cannot generally discharge, and a hypothesis-parametrised OrderIso.map_tsub cannot fire as a simp lemma. In the grep, map_tsub_of_le is used once, in Presburger/Semilinear/Basic.lean, as `rw [← map_tsub_of_le ...]`, so an attribute is not needed there. The proof of OrderIso.map_tsub uses `simpa` and relies on existing simp lemmas for symm applications, which is fine. I found no competing rules, loops, or missing canonical simp lemmas. I did not check every downstream use across Mathlib.
